# VPS Proxy Deployment Guide

> Agent-readable index for a self-hosted Hysteria2, VLESS and Clash Verge Rev guide. Templates only; no live service or credentials. Updated 2026-09-13.

## Start here
- [Overview](README.md): scope, architecture, limits and tests.
- [Agent contract](AGENTS.md): permissions, privacy and staged deployment.
- [Deployment](docs/deployment.md): VPS selection to client setup.
- [Parameters](docs/parameters.example.md): values the recipient must supply.
- [Verification](docs/verification.md): real-world acceptance and recovery.
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): concise answers to common questions.
- [Release status](docs/release-status.md): offline evidence and publication limits.
